text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending an amendment to a previously approved car-share vehicle parking area (CVPA) on Harrison Garden Boulevard.

North York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing car-share vehicle parking area for two Zipcar vehicles on the west side of Harrison Garden Boulevard, between a point 110 metres south of Avondale Avenue and a point 12 metres further south, to be in effect between a point 110 metres south of Avondale Avenue and a point 6 metres further south, for one Zipcar vehicle. 2. Amended the existing parking prohibition regulation in effect at all times on the west side of Harrison Garden Boulevard, between a point 110 meters south of Avondale Avenue and a point 12 metres further south (car-share vehicles excepted), to be in effect at all times on the west side of Harrison Garden Boulevard, between a point 110 metres south of Avondale Avenue and a point 6 metres further south (car-share vehicles excepted). 3.
